working_definition: T4a neurons of Hörmann et al. 2020: one of the authors' eight clusters at each stage, assigned to subtype T4a by marker genes; FACS-sorted T4/T5 neurons, 24 and 36 h APF (pupal).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T4a neuron (Hormann et al., 2020). Early during its development, it projects its axon to lobula plate layer 1 (Hormann et al., 2020).

justification: The authors assign the cluster to subtype T4a; FBbt has the immature term for it (defined from this paper), as the stage requires.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal front-to-back direction (Henning et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052263 immature T4a neuron (exact match).
